nodes.label: Spring AI Alibaba (SAA)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as an AI framework bridging Spring AI's low-level atomic abstractions with enterprise-grade multi-agent application development, deeply integrated with Alibaba Cloud's Bailian ecosystem. Addresses the gap between simple chatbot demos and production-grade multi-agent systems.

nodes.label: Spring AI
nodes.rationale: Spring community's official open-source AI framework released as 1.0 GA in May 2025. Focuses on low-level atomic capability abstractions (ChatModel, Prompt, RAG, ChatMemory, Tool, MCP) and seamless integration with Spring Boot ecosystem.

nodes.label: Spring AI Alibaba Graph
nodes.rationale: Designed as a Java equivalent of Langgraph to help developers build workflow and multi-agent applications. Key design differentiator from Spring AI: adds higher-level orchestration with pre-built Nodes and simplified State definitions, enabling low-code to high-code agent construction.

nodes.label: Bailian Platform (百炼平台)
nodes.rationale: Alibaba Cloud's visual AI agent development platform providing model access, RAG knowledge base management, and data vectorization preprocessing capabilities.

nodes.label: ChatClient
nodes.rationale: Spring AI's most core component for building chatbot/single-agent applications. Supports The Augmented LLM pattern by mounting Retrieval, Tools, and Memory as external data and services. Preferred for simple direct agent patterns but degrades when too many tools/context are given to the model.

nodes.label: JManus
nodes.rationale: Evolved from an OpenManus replica to an agent development platform. Strategic pivot: recognizing that pure autonomous planning cannot solve deterministic enterprise scenarios, JManus now aims to let users build vertical-domain agents through natural language interaction, with plans to convert generated plans into Spring AI Alibaba engineering projects.

nodes.label: DeepResearch Agent
nodes.rationale: A deep research agent built on Spring AI Alibaba Graph with tools like Web Search, Crawling, and Python script engine to help users complete in-depth research reports.

nodes.label: The Augmented LLM
nodes.rationale: A design pattern from Anthropic's 'Building Effective AI Agents' article. Allows models to access external data (RAG), tools, and memory during inference. Augments raw LLM capabilities with domain-specific data and external API integration.

nodes.label: PLAN-ACT Mode
nodes.rationale: An agent execution pattern enabling complex reasoning, step-by-step execution, and dynamic adjustment. Suitable for multi-turn dialogue, complex decision-making, and automated workflow scenarios.

nodes.label: ChatBot Pattern (Single Agent)
nodes.rationale: The simplest AI agent development pattern: give all tools and context to a single model and let it decide and iterate until completion. Ideal in theory but degrades when too many tools/context are provided, causing models to deviate from expected behavior.

nodes.label: Workflow Pattern
nodes.rationale: A deterministic task decomposition pattern where humans pre-define branching flows. Models act as classification/decision nodes within fixed pipelines. Strengths: high determinism, good for intent recognition. Weaknesses: requires deep business understanding, underutilizes model reasoning, criticized as 'not intelligent enough'.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Pattern
nodes.rationale: A task decomposition approach where multiple sub-agents communicate and collaborate with more autonomy and flexibility than workflows. Follows specific communication models (e.g., ReAct Agent, Supervisor) while retaining decision-making freedom within each agent.
